claims.statement_id: Ball-tailed cat adalah "fearsome critter" Amerika Utara yang mirip singa gunung, tetapi berekor sangat panjang dengan gumpalan padat di ujungnya untuk memukul mangsa.
claims.quote: is a fearsome critter of North American folklore most commonly described as having similar traits to that of a mountain lion, except with an exceedingly long tail to which there is affixed a solid, bulbous mass for striking its prey.

claims.statement: Ball-tailed cat tales were common among woodsmen around the turn of the 20th century.
claims.statement_id: Kisah ball-tailed cat umum di kalangan penghuni hutan sekitar pergantian abad ke-20.
claims.quote: Tales of ball-tailed cats were common among woodsmen during the turn of the 20th century

claims.statement: Two prominent variants are the Dingmaul and the Sliver Cat.
claims.statement_id: Dua variannya yang terkenal adalah Dingmaul dan Sliver Cat.
claims.quote: two of the more prominent variants are the Dingmaul and the Sliver Cat.

claims.statement: The earliest written mention is in Henry Tyron's Fearsome Critters (1939).
claims.statement_id: Catatan tertulis paling awal muncul dalam Fearsome Critters karya Henry Tyron (1939).
claims.quote: The earliest written mention of the ball-tailed cat appears in Henry Tyron's Fearsome Critters (1939).
